sentences.text: Watertight integrity means keeping water out of the hull.
In rough water, close hatches, ports and doors.
Scuppers and freeing ports must be kept clear so water on deck drains overboard instead of building up.
Below the waterline, inspect every seacock, hose and fitting, and use double stainless hose clamps.
A failed hose or through-hull fitting is one of the most common reasons boats sink at the dock.
Underway, water pouring through an open hatch in heavy seas, called down-flooding, can sink a boat in minutes.
